title: Finding, freeing (via a wits check on the quartermaster's ledger, at no gold cost), and safely returning Lys's brother Cal produced warm closing narration ('She is really coming home... I keep checking over my shoulder like he might vanish') but no regard change for Lys at that moment — companion personal-quest payoffs don't consistently move the regard number the way ordinary dialogue choices do.
